data_erasure.title: Erase data
data_erasure.locked: This page erases data of {{company}} for all its members. Only an owner opens it, after confirming it is really them.
data_erasure.confirmed: Identity confirmed at {{time}}. The page closes after 10 minutes without action; confirming again reopens it.
data_erasure.kept: Issued invoices, credit notes and delivery notes, their numbers and their PDFs · recorded payments and expenses · closings · the activity journal · members, their roles and the subscription. Keep a copy first: every list has « Export ».
data_erasure.waiting: An erasure is still waiting for its end: undo it from the banner, or wait until it is final, before making another.

preview.title: What will be erased
preview.counted: Counted just now, without touching anything. It disappears from every member’s screens on « Erase »; the erasure is written to the activity journal.
preview.undoable: for 24 hours, from the « Undo the erasure » banner; after that nothing comes back.
preview.proof: If your identity confirmation is more than 5 minutes old, it is asked again when erasing.

errors.network: The server did not answer; try again.
errors.owner_only: Only an owner erases the company’s data.
errors.step_up_required: Confirm again that it is really you.
errors.erasure_pending: An erasure is still waiting for its end: undo it or wait until it is final.
errors.erasure_final: This erasure is final: nothing comes back.
errors.erasure_conflict: Nothing came back: {{table}} made since stands where what was erased would go. Clear it, then undo again.
errors.erasure_conflict_any: Nothing came back: something made since stands where what was erased would go.
errors.no_part: Choose at least one part to erase.
